clock-elapsed.message: test-audit clock: assert work done (calls, renders, rows), never elapsed time (docs/testing.md)

unheld-clock.message: test-audit unheld: fake the whole clock (vi.useFakeTimers({ now })) so real timers cannot run behind the test (docs/testing.md)
